affiliation.name: Caltech Library, California Institute of Technology

description: logagent helps Caltech Library detect and mitigate automated traffic against its public web services. It reads nginx and Apache 2 access logs and configuration, so it works from the Library's own servers and does not depend on one vendor's edge. It judges behavior and not identity, keeps detailed data only briefly, and keeps long-term data only as aggregates, to protect reader privacy.
name: logagent
